a.xlink:href:
https://app.diagrams.net/
MethodEndpoint PathStatusKey Request Payload / QueryResponse & Security Features
POST/auth/magic-linkNEW{"email": "user@gmail.com"}Rate Limited (5/min). Auto-creates unverified user, generates SHA-256 hashed token & 6-digit OTP code, sends email.
GET/auth/magic-link/verifyNEW?token=RAW_URL_TOKENDirect clickable URL from email. Marks is_email_verified=True, issues Access Token & sets HttpOnly Refresh Cookie.
POST/auth/magic-link/verify-tokenNEW{"token": "RAW_URL_TOKEN"}Single Page App token verification. Issues Access Token & sets HttpOnly Refresh Cookie.
POST/auth/magic-link/verify-codeNEW{"email": "...", "code": "123456"}Rate Limited (10/min). Manual 6-digit OTP code entry for Mobile & Swagger UI.
POST/auth/googleNEW{"id_token": "GOOGLE_JWT"}Rate Limited (10/min). Cryptographically verifies Google OIDC ID token, extracts Google name & avatar CDN URL, auto-registers user.
POST/auth/refreshUPDATEDHeader Cookie or JSON bodyDual Support. Reads refresh token from HttpOnly Cookie (web) or JSON body (mobile), revokes old token, issues new pair.
POST/auth/logoutUPDATEDHeader Cookie or JSON bodyRevokes active refresh token record in PostgreSQL & deletes HttpOnly Cookie in browser.
GET/auth/meUPDATEDAuthorization: Bearer <token>Returns user profile (id, email, role, profile_image_url, auth_provider, is_email_verified).
DELETE/admin/users/cleanup-unverifiedNEW?max_age_hours=24Admin Only. Deletes orphaned unverified typo accounts older than 24 hours.

tr.td: Admin Only. Deletes orphaned unverified typo accounts older than 24 hours.

text.tspan: MethodEndpoint PathStatusKey Request Payload / QueryResponse & Security FeaturesPOST/auth/magic-linkNEW{"email": "user@gmail.com"}Rate Limited (5/min). Auto-creates unverified
user, generates SHA-256 hashed token & 6-digit OTP code, sends email.GET/auth/magic-link/verifyNEW?token=RAW_URL_TOKENDirect clickable URL from email. Marks
is_email_verified=True, issues Access Token & sets HttpOnly Refresh Cookie.POST/auth/magic-link/verify-tokenNEW{"token": "RAW_URL_TOKEN"}Single Page App token verification. Issues
Access Token & sets HttpOnly Refresh Cookie.POST/auth/magic-link/verify-codeNEW{"email": "...", "code": "123456"}Rate Limited (10/min). Manual 6-digit OTP code entry for Mobile & Swagger
UI.POST/auth/googleNEW{"id_token": "GOOGLE_JWT"}Rate Limited (10/min). Cryptographically verifies Google OIDC ID token, extracts Google name & avatar CDN URL, auto-registers
user.POST/auth/refreshUPDATEDHeader Cookie or JSON bodyDual Support. Reads refresh token from HttpOnly Cookie (web) or JSON body (mobile), revokes old token, issues new
pair.POST/auth/logoutUPDATEDHeader Cookie or JSON bodyRevokes active refresh token record in PostgreSQL & deletes HttpOnly Cookie in browser.GET/auth/meUPDATEDAuthorization:
Bearer <token>Returns user profile (id, email, role, profile_image_url, auth_provider, is_email_verified).DELETE/admin/users/cleanup-unverifiedNEW?max_age_hours=24Admin Only. Deletes
orphaned unverified typo accounts older than 24 hours.

text.tspan: Start([User opens Mobile App or Website]) --> Request[GET /product or GET /categories]
CheckCache -- YES (Cache Hit) --> RAMReturn[Return JSON directly from RAM\n⚡ 0.1ms Latency]
RAMReturn --> ClientEnd([Display Products / Categories to User])
CheckCache -- NO (Cache Miss) --> ServiceQuery[Query PostgreSQL Database]
DBPool --> IndexSearch[Search B-Tree Indexes\nselectinload gallery images]
IndexSearch --> SaveCache[Save copy in RAM Cache\nTTL: 2 to 5 mins]
